Nina Rodriguez  
Los Angeles, CA | (213) 555-0198 | nina.rodriguez@email.com  

A junior machine learning engineer specializing in adtech, with a focus on scalable recommendation systems and data-driven optimization. Currently contributing to ad targeting pipelines at AdLift Technologies, with prior experience in user segmentation, A/B testing, and model deployment.  

**Projects**  
*User Segmentation Model (BannerAds Inc., 2023)*  
Developed a Python/SQL-based segmentation framework to categorize 2M+ users into 12 behavioral clusters, improving ad relevance by 12% through collaborative filtering techniques.  

*Ad Performance Prediction System (ClickBoost Dynamics, 2023)*  
Built an A/B testing infrastructure using PyTorch and scikit-learn, enabling rapid iteration of bid strategies that increased CTR by 8% across 150+ ad campaigns.  

*Recommendation System Optimization (AdLift Technologies, 2024)*  
Refactored a legacy collaborative filtering pipeline, reducing inference latency by 20% and improving model accuracy by 9% through hyperparameter tuning and feature engineering.  

**Professional Experience**  
*Data Analytics Intern | BannerAds Inc. (June 2023 – November 2023)*  
- Designed ETL workflows to aggregate user interaction data from 5 disparate sources, achieving 98% data consistency.  
- Implemented SQL-based cohort analysis tools to track user retention, supporting 10+ data-driven decisions.  
- Collaborated with cross-functional teams to document model performance metrics, reducing onboarding time for new analysts by 30%.  

*Machine Learning Intern | ClickBoost Dynamics (December 2023 – May 2024)*  
- Built a PyTorch-based neural network for ad click prediction, achieving 85% accuracy on validation sets.  
- Integrated TensorFlow models into production pipelines using MLflow, enabling version control for 15+ models.  
- Partnered with DevOps to containerize models with Docker, reducing deployment errors by 40%.  

*Junior Machine Learning Engineer | AdLift Technologies (June 2024 – Present)*  
- Maintained and optimized recommendation systems for 50M+ daily users, focusing on scalability and real-time performance.  
- Developed REST APIs to expose model outputs, integrating with 3 internal tools for ad targeting.  
- Contributed to Apache Airflow pipelines that process 10TB of data monthly, ensuring timely feature updates for models.

Bachelor of Science in Computer Science | University of Southern California | Graduated 2024
